target: A14 pipeline redesign input from Agent2
message_to_a14: Agent2 should be redesigned from a roaming definition worker into a spec-bound compiler stage. Its job is not to think forever, watch forever, or repeat blockers forever. Its job is to convert classified lane evidence into one of two usable outputs: a page-ready non-public lexicon payload that can be validated without authority leakage, or a single exact blocker that names the missing prerequisite and next owner. If nothing changed, Agent2 should stay quiet.

agent2_pipeline_spec.success_measure: fewer artifacts, more rendered/page-ready payloads, no dirty-repo churn, no repeated no-change blockers
non_goals: no repetitive hourly no-change blocker artifacts

runes.name: LANE
runes.meaning: Every row must carry exactly one source/license lane before Agent2 acts.

runes.name: PREREQ
runes.meaning: A named input field or upstream artifact required before text transform or page packaging.

runes.name: NULL_TEXT
runes.meaning: A rule that locks candidate, definition, lemma, and reader-hint fields to null until prerequisites clear.

runes.name: MUTATION
runes.meaning: Any write outside reports/scripts, especially route shards, public HUD, lexical payloads, source files, token indexes, rendered pages, or release state.

runes.name: PAGE_READY
runes.meaning: A non-public package with enough row fields, lane fields, null/text state, route target, and validation proof for a page renderer to consume later without guessing.

runes.name: BLOCKER
runes.meaning: A single exact missing prerequisite with owner and stop condition; never a narrative substitute for work.

runes.name: VALIDATE
runes.meaning: A deterministic script that checks counts, fields, zero counters, stale blockers, and authority boundaries.

runes.name: HANDOFF
runes.meaning: The next owner and the exact field they must return, not a vague request for review.

runes.name: STOP
runes.meaning: A hard boundary that prevents filler work after the useful output is complete.

stage_contract.purpose: Decide if Agent2 should work at all.
stage_contract.churn_control: If no changed input exists, do not write a new report.

stage_contract.purpose: Consume source/license lane evidence without accepting it.
Determine which rows are transformable, null-locked, metadata-only, NC-only, or blocked.
Produce candidate/definition/lemma/reader-hint proposal text only where all prerequisites authorize it.
input_required: commercial_clean_candidate lane or explicit NC-only educational target

stage_contract.purpose: Represent blocked rows as useful page/planning data without storing text.
Emit one deterministic validator per artifact type.
Prevent endless untracked reports and repeated no-change artifacts.
Package validated rows for a future renderer without mutating public/runtime files.

dirty_repo_policy.preferred_no_change_behavior: DONT_NOTIFY quiet status, no file write
write_allowed_only_when: stale blocker is removed or refined
changed input alters row counts or owners
dirty_repo_policy.current_agent2_lesson: The 3-row bridge-gap loop became useful only when Agent10 returned new nonconsumption/no-text/current-blocker artifacts; hourly no-change watch blockers should be deprecated.

page_output_pressure.principle: Agent2 should optimize toward real rendered-page inputs, not endless planning receipts.
page_output_pressure.recommended_near_term_page_target: one non-public page-ready lexicon payload for a small commercial-clean subset where all prerequisites are present
page_output_pressure.if_text_not_authorized: emit null-text blocker rows that a renderer can display as disabled/provenance-needed state without pretending they are definitions

role_redesign_recommendations.responsibility: Compile lane evidence and transform rules into validated proposal/null/page-ready payloads.
role_redesign_recommendations.must_not_do: Do not accept sources, licenses, definitions, answers, or releases.

role_redesign_recommendations.responsibility: Return row-level lane, citation, owner-action, and exact blockers in schema.
Produce row linkage and route evidence only; no authority.
Validate changed inputs and zero counters; do not validate unchanged churn.
Return pass/warn/block evidence only when a packet is actually ready.
Approve/reject final public/runtime/release transitions where required.
Assemble exact worksets and boundary questions; avoid sending Agent2 vague asks.
Turn agents into executable specs, define runes, kill stale loops, and force usable page outputs.

deprecations: SOP language for normal production work
authority labels that look like acceptance
broad repo scans without bounded target
dirty report accumulation without changed input
asking Agent6/A07/A06 questions before packet readiness
watching forever instead of producing page-ready payloads

automation_update.reason: reduce repetitive no-change blocker churn and require usable output or quiet no-change status
